title: Autonomous gas-phase geometry investigation of Ph-BODIPY
difficulty_reasons: The endpoint is fixed but the agent must independently choose a conformer/method scope, discriminate candidates, validate minima and justify stopping and coverage.
The indexed molecular connectivity provides no starting coordinates, so constructing and deduplicating a chemically sensible finite starting ensemble is part of the exploration.

paper.title: Precise molecular structure of meso‑phenyl-BODIPY in the gas phase

data.description: Answer-neutral indexed connectivity and composition for neutral-singlet Ph-BODIPY; no coordinates or reference geometry.

required_deliverables.description: Outcome-branch report containing candidate evidence and, on success, validated indexed coordinates and observables.
